notes.title: Multiplatform Update 1.3.3.4
notes.content:
Thank you for your support at launch! We truly appreciate every one of you — your feedback helps us improve the game.

This update brings:

New atmospheric artwork

Text corrections

Linux and macOS support

What’s next:

More art and gameplay tweaks

Marketing push

Steam achievements

Are you a Steam curator interested in covering us? Contact narwhalstudio@mail.ru!
